name: DinoBot
_note: THE one place for the product's names. name: shown to users. id: command, ~/.<id> dir, service and tarball names (dinobot, owner decision 27 Oct). bundleId: iOS app (test id). installUrl: the one-line command's script (owner decision: not shortened). downloadBaseUrl: tarballs (GitHub Releases of releaseRepo; install.sh and `update` download from it). releaseRepo: the GitHub repo that builds, signs and publishes releases. install.sh carries stamped copies of name, id and downloadBaseUrl; build/build-tarball.sh restamps them and test/wave2.test.mjs fails on drift.
